name: MS 301 Redirect Manager
author: magespider

sections.description:
MS 301 Redirect Manager helps you redirect old URLs to new URLs using permanent (301) redirects.

It is perfect for:
* SEO improvement
* Fixing broken links
* Website migrations
* URL structure changes

Features

  • Add unlimited 301 redirects
  • Simple and clean user interface
  • SEO friendly redirects
  • Lightweight and fast
  • No coding required
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu
  3. Go to MS 301 Redirect Manager in the WordPress admin menu
  4. Add your old and new URLs
sections.faq:
Does this plugin affect SEO?

Yes. It improves SEO by fixing broken links using 301 redirects.

Is this plugin beginner friendly?

Yes. No technical knowledge is required.
